thread:
nina_pm: FYI vendor sent an updated delivery note. MI300 image now requires a specific firmware blob and B200 has a sustained-power caveat. Need to align marketplace onboarding + SI soak plan before we open SKUs.

yves_vendor: Confirmed. MI300: firmware v2.0.0 mandatory for our validated images; B200 SKU B200-X has a thermal throttling profile above 650W in long runs. We're recommending patch fw-2.0.1 which reduces throttling but still under verification.

kai_eng: Can you share the thermal logs or the minimal repro? our perf docs and bench configs will change if sustained power is lower.

yves_vendor: Uploading logs to the partner bucket, link in DM. Short summary: 6hr stress with longbench-v3 shows temp climb and ~12% tail latency increase on top-shelf SKU. Patch fw-2.0.1 lowers temps ~6C in their lab.

oliver_si: SI ask: we need the final firmware image + SHA, an integration checklist, and a soak recipe. We'll need 72h soak across two regions (US-EAST, EU-WEST) to match customer patterns.

emma_market: Marketplace constraints: we can't publish SKU rows until we have signed image SHAs and a regional availability plan. Also need a legal-approved partner quote for the marketplace tile if we're co-announcing. 7 business days prep minimum.

notify-bot: nina_pm scheduled: "B200/MI300 marketplace handoff: firmware + soak plan" on 2025-03-20 09:30 PT with nina_pm, yves_vendor, kai_eng, emma_market, oliver_si. Invite sent.

kai_eng: Proposed quick bake of required artifacts: 1) image naming convention (we'll use `redwood/hw/{vendor}/{sku}/{fw_sha}`), 2) CI gating rule, 3) fallback routing if SI fails. Example image name:
```
redwood/hw/venco/B200-X/sha-abcdef123456
```

oliver_si: Soak recipe draft:
```
soak:
  duration: 72h
  benches: [longbench-v3, regen-chatload]
  telemetry: [power, temp, tail_latency, kv_cache_hit]
  acceptance: no perf drop > 8% and temp < 82C
```

nina_pm: Action list before sync (owners/due):
- yves_vendor: upload fw-2.0.1 build + logs + SKU impact list (due: EOD tomorrow)
- kai_eng: PR with image naming + CI gating rules (due: +48h)
- oliver_si: SI acceptance template + soaked region plan (due: +48h)
- emma_market: embargo draft + marketplace tile checklist (due: sync)

yves_vendor: Will do. If our lab or yours sees regressions we'll flag a GA delay of up to 14 days.

emma_market: One more ask: if GA slips, marketing needs a new briefing doc for partner comms so press quotes don't leak.

kai_eng: For the fallback, we should have a compatibility mapping that routes affected workloads to H100-compatible model variants with reduced batch sizes and alerts. I'll sketch the routing policy.

oliver_si: We'll also prepare a short rollback runbook in case images regress after marketplace release. Stubbing now and will add steps for revoking SKUs.

nina_pm: Good. We'll review everything in the scheduled sync and lock the embargo if all green. Post any blockers here ASAP. :thumbsup:

emma_market: Noted. Adding legal to the calendar invite.

yves_vendor: Copying partner release manager to join the call.

notify-bot: Thread archived into calendar event notes.
